convert_mask2former_checkpoint: convert a Mask2Former Detectron2 checkpoint to HuggingFace transformers format using CLI arguments
build_mask2former_config_converter: build a Mask2FormerConfig from an original Detectron2 config by mapping model hyperparameters and label mappings
convert_image_processor_config: convert a Detectron2 config into a Mask2FormerImageProcessor with pixel mean, std, and size settings
convert_swin_backbone_weights: convert Swin backbone state dict keys from Detectron2 naming to HuggingFace transformer layer naming
convert_transformer_decoder_weights: convert transformer decoder QKV projections and attention layers from Detectron2 to HuggingFace format
